messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the INC-2026-0422 postmortem — pattern: periodic latency spikes tied to bursty KV invalidations and autoscaler overshoot. want to lock owners and SLO temp adjustments.
maya: suggest p95 -> 220ms for 4 weeks, with two checkpoints: 1) 72-hour review after canary, 2) 4-week debrief. rollback if p95 < 175ms for 10d.
anna (SRE): sounds reasonable. propose also reducing the throughput SLO threshold window for the temp period (from 1m->30s) so quick bursts don't count against error budget.
devon: agree on owners: anna -> kernel/serving investigation, kelsey -> autoscaler tuning, rick -> customer comms + SLA updates, maya -> SLO governance doc update + follow-up report.
kelsey: will take autoscaler. plan: tighten scale-down grace, tune scale-up smoothing, and add a per-pool circuit breaker. aim: canary in 5 days.
rick: I'll draft comms. do we want to notify paid customers now or wait until canary results?
maya: wait until 72-hour review unless the canary shows user-facing errors. rick, please prep copy but don't send.
anna (SRE): dashboard tasks: add p95, p99, QPS by pool, kv-invalidation rate. also add annotation layer for canary start/stop and incidents.
anna (SRE): sample PromQL for 99p by pool:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_latency_seconds_bucket[2m])) by (le, pool))
```
anna (SRE): and KV invalidation rate:
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_invalidation_events_total[5m])) by (pool)
```
sre-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-0422-FOLLOWUP (#3587). Linked postmortem and assigned owners: anna,kelsey,rick,maya.
ops-bot: Oncall this week: anna (SRE). Reminder set for 2279720000.
devon: action list with ETA draft — please ack if correct or update:
- Dashboard + annotations (48h): anna
- Canary autoscaler + circuit breaker (start in 5d): kelsey
- Kernel perf investigation (2w): anna
- Customer comms draft (72h): rick
- SLO governance update & public note (5d): maya
- Add recurrence detection job to SRE cadence (monthly): devon
kelsey: ack and noted. adding rollback: if p99 > 400ms for 15m during canary, abort and revert.
anna (SRE): ack. will add 99p alarm to runbook for immediate paging on regression.
rick: ack. draft in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=inc3587-comms-draft (private). will request legal review after we lock the window.
maya: added extra clause to SLO governance: temporary SLO windows must include clear metric, duration, and rollback criteria. will patch page and ping #all-hands after comms go out.
devon: timeline summary: 48h dashboard, canary in 5d, perf investigation 2w, reassess at 72h post-canary and at 4 weeks. error budget auto-reset rules to be appended to ticket.
anna (SRE): also recommend adding a weekly recurring query to flag this pattern: run detection for KV invalidation spikes > 2x baseline for 3+ windows. i'll add to alerts board.
kelsey: scheduling canary now and will include staged rollout across pools A->B->C. rollback script linked in runbook PR.
rick: prepping customer segmentation for comms so only affected accounts see notice.
maya: please drop a one-line "owned" in thread when you've created PR/ticket links so I can finalize assignment in #3587.
anna (SRE): owned (dashboard PR #912).
kelsey: owned (canary plan in #3587, runbook PR #77).
rick: owned (comms draft linked).
devon: thanks everyone. i'll update the incident tracker and add the 4-week review meeting invite. :thumbsup:
